scope: bounded public access, material, and external-route diagnostic only; no screening, candidate construction, import, or final event

claims.statement: One public same-origin PDF returned HTTP 200, application/pdf, a PDF signature, pdfinfo success, and pdftotext success; no PDF bytes or text were retained persistently.
A public ZIP attachment rejected HEAD with HTTP 400 but returned HTTP 206, application/zip, and ZIP magic for a 1024-byte GET range. Full archive parsing was not run.
Public category output can disclose protected folder flags while omitting public attachment rows for those folders; no authentication was attempted.
The public ESA general-search page was a generic Search page rather than an Indico object route.

ESA Publications listings describe formal ESA reference-number listings, and the ESA Archives Portal describes historical/archive holdings, separate search infrastructure, rights, and login-gated downloads.
The local method must treat retrieval, unsupported type, archive-member, parse, checksum, and unprotected-access failures as coverage failures, not negative lexical matches.

untested: Full ZIP recursion and all non-PDF parser behavior.
Attachment type=link behavior on a live public link record and the approved boundary treatment of external targets.
Server rate-limit ceiling and full-run storage requirements.
